blocks.text: Moto Boho is a popular fashion trend in the mid-late 2010s to the mid 2020s that diffuses the rugged, rustic, rebellious edge of motorcycle culture with the free-spirited, soft, romance of bohemian style. It leans on the "soft vs hard" juxtaposition which pairs gritty textures like distressed metal studs and leather with delicate fabrics like chiffon, lace, and crochet.
Bags: Oversized fringed suede shoulder bags or slouchy leather hobo bags.
Hardware: Gold or silver chains, heavily chunky studded belts, earrings and crystal-studded accessories.
Footwear: Heavy-duty biker boots with chunky combat boots, python-print western boots, or metal buckles.
Base Layers: Ruffled chiffon dresses, white prairie silhouettes, flowy tiered maxi skirts, and sheer lace tops.
Outerwear: Jackets, cropped moto jackets, oversized biker leathers, pants, dresses, distressed, fringed leather coats or suede blazers.
Palette: Grounded base of black, oxblood, moody, deep brown, and forest green lightened up by sun-washed creams, whites, and faded pastels.
